reviewRound.commit: REPLACE with the 40-hex commit that holds the packet

reviewReport.commit: REPLACE with the 40-hex commit that holds the report (the commit that added it, which the report itself cannot name)

alignment.reportReviewedRevision: REPLACE with the report's reviewedRevision.revision, or null if it cannot be resolved
alignment.status: REPLACE with matched, mismatched or unresolved

performedBy.role: REPLACE with a role other than the reviewer's

findings.findingId: REPLACE with a finding id from the report
findings.status: REPLACE with reproduced, not-reproduced, not-applicable or blocked

evidence.description: REPLACE: what you did and what it showed.

decision.status: REPLACE with accept, reject or request-revision; abstain or rerun when alignment is not matched
basedOnFindings: REPLACE with reproduced finding ids only

provenance.commit: REPLACE with the 40-hex commit you wrote the decision against: git rev-parse HEAD in the repository that holds the round, before you commit the decision. A file cannot name the commit that adds it
